ui_bugs.issue: TouchableOpacity uses raw `data-testid="dashboard-profile-avatar"` prop — React Native Web does not forward unknown props, so no `[data-testid="dashboard-profile-avatar"]` node exists in the DOM. Playwright querySelector returned null; had to click by coordinates. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx:77

Outer <View> uses only `data-testid="training-records-section"` (no `testID`). RN Web does not forward it to the DOM, so the selector returns null even though the section renders. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:218

action_items: Add `testID="dashboard-profile-avatar"` (in addition to or in place of `data-testid`) on the TouchableOpacity at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx:77 so RN Web renders `data-testid` in the DOM — improves testability without changing behavior.
Add `testID="training-records-section"` on the wrapper <View> at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:218 (same rationale). Feature works; only the testID selector is missing at DOM level.

Two low/medium-priority testID forwarding issues (data-testid vs testID) noted but do NOT block functionality — feature works end-to-end when clicking via coordinates or fallback. Pattern to reuse: RN Web only forwards `testID` (which becomes `data-testid`); raw `data-testid` on non-DOM RN components (View, TouchableOpacity, Text) is silently dropped. Use coordinate click (346,120) on 390×844 viewport as a workaround for avatar-open flows until testID is added.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to RCA. Testability observation: React Native Web's createElement pipeline forwards only the `testID` prop as the `data-testid` DOM attribute; passing `data-testid` directly to RN primitives like <View>/<TouchableOpacity> is dropped by the props filter, so the attribute never lands in the DOM. Fix: switch to `testID` (or add both) on those two elements.
